bogofilter_dir.description: Directory where wordlist.db and metadata are stored

cache_size.description: Tokyo Cabinet cache size in MiB

sp_esf.description: Effective size factor for spam counts (0 = disabled)

ns_esf.description: Effective size factor for non-spam counts (0 = disabled)

min_dev.description: Minimum deviation from 0.5 required for a token to be used in classification

robx.description: Spammish probability assigned to unseen tokens (0.0 to 1.0)

robs.description: Weight applied to robx for new/unseen tokens (0.0 to 1.0)

spam_cutoff.description: Score >= this is classified as spam

ham_cutoff.description: Score <= this is ham; between ham_cutoff and spam_cutoff => unsure (tristate mode)

spam_header_name.description: Name of header field used to report classification result

log_tag.description: Tag used in syslog messages when -l or -L is enabled

timestamp.description: Override current date for token timestamping (0 = disable)

extra_config.description: List of raw configuration lines to append verbatim (e.g., --skip-header-fields=Message-Id,Date,...)
